div.head: VI As 5
div.ab: Fifte: Þæt man ne forlǽte náne ǽscan naðer ne be norðan mearce ne be suðan, ǽr ælc man hæbbe áne ráde geríden þe hors habbe; ⁊ se þe hors nabbe, wyrce þam hlaforde þe him fore ríde oððe gánge, oð ðæt he ham cúme, buton man ǽr to rihte cuman mæge.

Fifth : No quest shall be abandoned either on the northern or the southern boundary until every man who has a horse has ridden out once. And he who has not a horse shall go on working for his lord, when the latter is proceeding on horse-back or on foot in his stead, until he [the lord] comes home — unless justice has already been obtained.

Quintim: ne intermittatur aliquod uestigium (ali[qu]a uestigatio) uel a septentrionali merca uel australi, priusquam omnis homo unam equitationem equitauerit, qui equum habeat; et qui equum non habeat, operetur domino qui equitabit pro eo uel pedes eat, donec ille domum redeat, si antea consequi non poterit.
